result: Implemented typed advisory shadow Workstream persistence. LegacyState.read clones the typed legacy FocusaState through a shared reference, ShadowWorkstreamStore.write materializes only proven mappings under exact WorkstreamKey values, and ambiguous, unmapped, foreign, invalid, or conflicting inputs remain in append-only quarantine without an inferred owner. ParityComparator.compare is bounded and distinguishes equal mapped state, expected unsafe-fallback removal, migration mismatch, quarantined ambiguity, deprecated data, and serialization-only differences.
checks: python3 tests/spec158_workstream_shadow_source_test.py (exit 0; positive and hostile source contract: PASS)
remaining_checks: cargo test -p focusa-core workstream_shadow_materialization --lib (not run; Cargo is prohibited for this corrective pass)
remaining_work: Cargo runtime execution only; no unresolved source implementation work remains

negative_cases.ambiguous_mapping: Two mappings for one legacy source produce zero shadow rows, retain both exact candidate WorkstreamKeys in quarantine, and compare as quarantined ambiguity.
negative_cases.unmapped_record: A canonical legacy record without a proven mapping is quarantined as UnmappedLegacyRecord and never receives an implicit owner.
negative_cases.foreign_scope: A declared legacy scope that disagrees with the mapping scope is quarantined as ConflictingProjectRoots.
negative_cases.conflicting_mapping: Multiple mappings for one source are quarantined as MultipleCandidateWorkstreams or ConflictingWorkstreamMappings; no merge or default assignment occurs.
negative_cases.unsafe_fallback: Unsafe fallback records are retained as immutable evidence and reported as ExpectedRemovalOfUnsafeFallback rather than materialized.
negative_cases.deprecated_data: Deprecated records are retained as immutable evidence and reported as DeprecatedData rather than materialized.
negative_cases.shadow_authority: The shadow store exposes shared row/quarantine access only, has no reducer or mutable state accessor, and reports itself advisory.

acceptance.proof: workstream_shadow_materialization::equal_mapped_state_passes_bounded_parity asserts one exact mapping materializes one row and ParityDisposition::EqualMappedState makes ParityReport::passes true; the required Cargo execution is deferred.

workstream_shadow_materialization::ambiguous_mapping_is_quarantined_without_default_assignment asserts zero rows, MultipleCandidateWorkstreams quarantine, both candidate WorkstreamKeys, and QuarantinedAmbiguity parity; the required Cargo execution is deferred.

acceptance.statement: Shadow output is advisory and cannot become a second mutable canonical truth.
acceptance.proof: ShadowWorkstreamStore has private rows, quarantine, and omission storage, shared-only accessors, no reducer path, and is_advisory() returns true.

acceptance.statement: Parity comparison distinguishes all Spec 158 §6 dispositions.
acceptance.proof: ParityDisposition defines EqualMappedState, ExpectedRemovalOfUnsafeFallback, MigrationMismatch, QuarantinedAmbiguity, DeprecatedData, and SerializationOnlyDifference; canonical_json separates semantic equality from raw serialization differences.
